Message:
The day my village
was attacked,
I ran away and
abandoned my family,

It was that moment when my
power of immortality was born.

A cursed power that forces me
to live forever in pain.

And the only thing that can
let me die is...this flower.

I have no idea why
it started withering.
I’d always assumed that,
since she gave her life
to make this flower,

Maybe...the power she poured
into the flower...is dwindling.

If I use it before it
completely withers away,
I can die.

But...I’ll live as a human,
and die as a human.
